description: Builds Agent Skills from idea to release. Use when creating or packaging a skill, turning a recurring workflow into a skill, or testing or repairing a skill's SKILL.md, trigger, or evals.

rows.query: can you package my transcript-to-blog-post workflow as a reusable skill with a template in assets and a script that strips the timestamps
add a new skill to the governance kit that checks every ledger entry has evidence before it is closed
build me a skill that converts my bank CSV exports into our ledger format, with the conversion done by a script instead of by hand
I want a new skill that drafts the app's social posts in Arabic and French from a feature changelog. Build it properly, with tests that show it beats just asking you.
I paste the same release-notes prompt every Friday and fix the same mistakes each time. Turn it into a proper skill for this project so it runs the same way every week.
make a skill for reviewing our Supabase migrations before they're applied: check RLS policies, indexes on foreign keys, and that a down migration exists
I need a skill for writing French cover letters from my CV and a job post. Design it so it loads only when I'm applying for a job.
Add a line to CLAUDE.md saying we use pnpm, not npm, in this repo.
Write the session report for today: what we changed in the ledger scripts and what is still open.
Write the prompt for the next session: it should pick up a tracked bug from the tracker and fix it test-first.
Explain how progressive disclosure works in Anthropic's Agent Skills and why the description is always loaded but the body isn't.
Write a hook that blocks git push --force on main in this repo.
Create a subagent definition in .claude/agents for reviewing SQL migrations with the database-reviewer persona.
Run an existing exam-writing skill to make next week's test on derivatives.
